verdict.rationale: AutoGen's docs describe GraphFlow for "multi-agent workflows through a directed graph of agents," which covers the explicit-graph part of the story. The pack also documents structured team patterns: RoundRobinGroupChat, SelectorGroupChat and Swarm handoffs. However, only one-line doc summaries describe GraphFlow, and nothing confirms branching, loops or parallel execution within the graph. Missing for 10: documented conditional branching, loop/cycle support, parallel fan-out/fan-in steps, in-depth GraphFlow docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
